name: Argentiferous-Paean
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond massive canyon systems the sky stays the color of a bruise.
Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Nothing about the exotic matter deposit appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
